name: Awale Resources Limited
summary: Awalé Resources Limited engages in the identification and exploration of mineral properties. The company primarily explores for gold deposits. Its flagship project is the Bondoukou property that includes three permits covering 1,191.5 square kilometers in the northeast of Côte d'Ivoire. The company was formerly known as Spada Gold Limited and changed its name to Awalé Resources Limited in December 2017. Awalé Resources Limited was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.
